decision_conditions:
Consent is refused for the following works: T7561 (London Plane) - 6m height reduction approximately (from 18m to 12m) and 3m lateral spread reduction approximately (from 9m to 6m).

The proposed reduction is excessive. The tree contributes significantly to local visual amenity and no structural defects requiring such works have been identified. A lesser, targeted lateral reduction of encroaching branches would be appropriate. The requested works are not necessary for safe management and would cause serious harm to visual amenity. Consent is therefore refused.
